_comment: Limits for the fly-machines target (OCI artefact, container PID 1). Sized for the 2 GB shared-cpu-1x machine (1 GB is below floor). Schema in deputyctl/src/limits.rs. Many baseline assumptions (systemd, AppArmor enforce, persistent daemons) do not hold inside a container; reflected here.

limitations.reason: Fly machines without an attached volume lose state on stop. The data partition is a Fly volume; if the volume is deleted, agent state is lost.
limitations.unblock: always attach a Fly volume mount per fly/fly.toml.example; back up to B2/R2

limitations.reason: Free Fly machines auto-stop and cold-start adds several seconds; not ideal for low-latency voice channels
limitations.unblock: set min_machines_running=1 on a paid plan to keep the machine warm

limitations.reason: Fly machines have no audio device; voice features disabled
limitations.unblock: deploy on rpi5 8GB+ or x86_64-mini-pc for voice

limitations.reason: AppArmor enforce mode requires --privileged or specific capability grants Fly's default machine config does not provide. Profiles ship in complain mode.
limitations.unblock: deploy to a Fly machine with the required Linux capabilities and toggle deputyos_apparmor_mode=enforce

limitations.reason: Container PID 1 is the agent; clamd as a background daemon is unreliable in this configuration. On-demand clamscan replaces it.
limitations.unblock: deploy on a non-container target (rpi5, mini-pc, DO, oracle) for persistent clamd

limitations.reason: Container runs the agent as PID 1; systemd is absent. deputyctl up on this target execs the agent in the foreground rather than poking systemd.
limitations.unblock: n/a — this is the documented Fly Machines behaviour. See fly/README.md.

limitations.reason: RAM tier 'low' (2 GB) far below local-LLM threshold; CPU is shared
limitations.unblock: fly-machines+gpu (paid, M3+) for vLLM, or pick a non-container target

limitations.reason: fly-machines target is too constrained for an airgap LLM bundle
limitations.unblock: use a different target (rpi5, x86_64-mini-pc, or a beefy cloud) for AIRGAP=1
